properties.name: CollectCoverage
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: collect coverage during dotnet test.

properties.name: CoverletOutputFormat
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: comma-separated report formats.

properties.name: CoverletOutput
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: the report file, or a folder when it ends with a slash.

properties.name: Threshold
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: the coverage percent below which the build fails.

properties.name: ThresholdType
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: what the threshold is about; comma-separated.

properties.name: ThresholdStat
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: the threshold is for every module, for the total or for the average.

properties.name: Exclude
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: filters of what is not measured: [Assembly]Namespace.Type.

properties.name: Include
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: filters of what is measured.

properties.name: ExcludeByFile
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: globs of source files that are not measured.

properties.name: ExcludeByAttribute
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: attributes whose targets are not measured, e.g. GeneratedCodeAttribute.

properties.name: MergeWith
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: a coverage.json of another run to merge with.

properties.name: SkipAutoProps
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: do not measure auto-implemented properties.

properties.name: UseSourceLink
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: report SourceLink URLs instead of local paths.

properties.name: DeterministicReport
properties.doc: coverlet.msbuild: paths of a deterministic build in the report.

properties.name: RunSettingsFilePath
properties.doc: The .runsettings dotnet test uses.

properties.name: VSTestLogger
properties.doc: The loggers of dotnet test, e.g. trx;LogFileName=results.trx.

properties.name: VSTestResultsDirectory
properties.doc: Where dotnet test writes the results.

properties.name: UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner
properties.doc: xunit.v3: run the tests by Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

properties.name: TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport
properties.doc: dotnet test runs the project through Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

properties.name: EnableMSTestRunner
properties.doc: MSTest: the project is its own runner (Microsoft.Testing.Platform).

properties.name: EnableNUnitRunner
properties.doc: NUnit: the project is its own runner (Microsoft.Testing.Platform).

properties.name: TestingPlatformCaptureOutput
properties.doc: false: show the output of the test process in dotnet test.

properties.name: TestingPlatformShowTestsFailure
properties.doc: Print the failed tests of a Microsoft.Testing.Platform run.

properties.name: GenerateTestingPlatformEntryPoint
properties.doc: false: the project has its own Main.
